RemediationStrings.Title: Endpoint protection (CrowdStrike) is not installed
RemediationStrings.Description: The required CrowdStrike Falcon sensor was not found on your device. Please contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Endpoint protection (CrowdStrike) is not running
RemediationStrings.Description: The CrowdStrike Falcon sensor is installed but its service is not running. Restart your device; if this message remains, contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Endpoint protection (CrowdStrike) is out of date
RemediationStrings.Description: Your CrowdStrike Falcon sensor is older than the minimum supported version. It normally updates on its own; please contact the helpdesk if this message remains.
